featured_reviews.name: RAVI SONI
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited this college to take an exam and faced several issues. Firstly, there is no parking available for two-wheelers, which caused me some inconvenience. However, the main problem arose during the exam when I needed to use the washroom. All the washrooms were locked, and upon inquiry, I was informed that they are reserved exclusively for staff. My exam hall was on the 6th floor, and the security personnel directed me to the 1st floor to access a washroom. This process wasted at least 15 minutes of my exam time.

My simple question to the management is: if you cannot provide basic facilities like accessible washrooms for students, why do you designate your institution as an exam center? Students shouldn’t have to approach the admin office for such fundamental needs. Locking washrooms is unacceptable. I hope you address this issue promptly. When students come to your college for exams, they deserve basic amenities like drinking water at their desks and nearby washroom access. Thank you.

featured_reviews.name: Tanveer Ahmed
featured_reviews.review_text:
As a father of two children at Orchids International School - Kurla, my experience has been decent but with some concerns.

While the school has a good curriculum and infrastructure, there are areas that need improvement.

The Positives:

Qualified Teachers – Most teachers are caring and make efforts to engage students.

Good Facilities – The classrooms and playgrounds are well-maintained.

Extracurricular Activities – A decent variety of activities to keep kids interested.

Areas for Improvement:
Communication Gaps – Sometimes, updates about school events or academic progress are delayed or unclear.

Homework & Workload – My son often feels overwhelmed with assignments.

Limited Individual Attention

The school has potential but needs better communication, workload management, and more focus on individual student needs. Hoping for positive changes in the future.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thank you for sharing your detailed feedback. We’re glad you value our teachers, facilities, and activities, and we’ll work on improving communication, workload balance, and individual attention.
